newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan buys 39,000 tonnes of Thai rice in tender.
newsitem.headline: Japan buys 39,000 tonnes of Thai rice in tender.

text.p: Japan's Food Agency said on Thursday it bought 39,000 tonnes of Thai rice in its second import tender of fiscal 1997/98, which began on April 1.
Of the total, 28,500 tonnes was non-glutinous long grain milled rice and the other 10,500 tonnes was non-glutinous broken milled rice.
The price was 51,136 yen per tonne, the agency said.
In the first rice import tender this year, carried out under the Simultaneous Buy and Sell (SBS) system on May 28, Japan bought 7,000 tonnes of foreign rice, the agency said.
In a General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade deal in 1993, Japan agreed to gradually open its rice market, pledging to buy 531,000 tonnes of foreign rice in fiscal 1997/98.
